steps.text: How long will Friday's bisque firing take? The kiln starts at 20 °C. Ramp 1: 80 °C an hour up to 600 °C. Ramp 2: 150 °C an hour up to 1000 °C, then hold for 15 minutes. I fire every week with different ramps, so make a small tool for it and call it kiln_ramp_time.
